intent: Operator-authorized WP-0F1/WP-0G closure slice: make every merge-authoritative workflow emit truthful evidence on a native merge-group candidate, keep DocOps generated counts advisory on pull-request and merge-group deltas but strict on scheduled/manual main audits, make rolling DocOps PR delivery check-triggering and fail closed until every canonical required context exists on the exact delivered head, and repair the Semgrep merge-group delta path exposed by the first live canary. This packet changes no runtime merge authority, does not re-enable legacy automerge or Merge Master Mike, and grants no bypass of branch protection or review-thread policy.

commit.message: fix(ci): make native merge queue evidence truthful

interface_mismatches: docops.yml infers pull-request mode from GITHUB_BASE_REF, which is absent on merge_group and makes queue candidates run the strict main-only generated-count policy.
coherence-delta.yml self-skips its required job on merge_group, producing no executed queue-candidate evidence.

docops-reconcile-main.yml applies the direct-main [skip ci] loop guard to rolling PR commits and accepts any single check run instead of proving that all six canonical required contexts exist on the exact delivered head.

semgrep.yml treats merge_group as a full-repository scan because it never selects merge_group.base_sha, so the live zero-red canary produced a red advisory check on pre-existing findings instead of evaluating the candidate delta.
honest_blockers: Structural and pull-request checks cannot establish native merge-group behavior; proof requires one real merge queue candidate after repository ruleset activation.

The native merge queue ruleset is live GitHub state, not repository content; retain classic protection until the second canary produces all six required checks and no failed merge-group workflow on its exact synthetic SHA.
The first native canary was safely invalidated after Semgrep exposed missing merge-group base semantics; a second live canary is required after this packet closes that exact defect.
session_entry.rollback: Before merge, disable or remove the canary ruleset and dequeue the PR. After merge, revert this commit only after disabling native merge queue; retain classic branch protection throughout. Do not re-enable the legacy automerge or Mike router as rollback.
